headline: Island Sectors Erupt as Coastal Handover Rates Surge Across Frontlines
war_summary: Since the last edition, the island theater at Fisherman’s Row has erupted into frantic contention, registering fourteen base transitions over the past two hours amidst contested landings at Eidolo and Black Well. Stlican Shelf maintains a relentless pace of clashes around Breaker Town, while Weathered Expanse continues to suffer staggering attrition, logging over three thousand casualties in two hours as fighting sweeps Frostmarch and Wightwalk. Fresh skirmishes have flared at Mox in Marban Hollow, alongside renewed base exchanges in Mooring County following an earlier lull. In Callahan’s Passage, direct ownership changes have paused, yet the sector remains locked in a fierce bloodbath with nearly four thousand casualties recorded in the latest two-hour window. Peripheral engagements in Nevish Line and Linn of Mercy sustain steady pressure, whereas the broader interior and southern supply hexes remain entirely quiet.
